chapter: Other bands, mutes, arrangers and composers
title: Emil Tasso and the Orpheum band
summary: Asked about Tasso, DeDroit says he led the Orpheum Theatre band and let him play jazz with the mute.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: If we'd have lived here, we had it anyway. I came across some names of other orchestras that played here, and I don't know what years this covered exactly, but maybe you could comment on some of these. These were mentioned in connection with some of the carnival balls. Yes. Tasso, of course you talked about him before. Tasso?
Tasso. Well, he was the leader at the Orffin Theatre.
Yeah, and he had his own legitimate band, a military style band?

Well, they taught playing jazz when I joined him. Yeah, and you knew what a good thing was. Just a little jazz, you know, with the mute. But with the acts, I bust loose. Do you have other bands there?
